description: This file is a test script for verifying correct usage of Azure SDK client instantiation within the azure client usage modules. It includes functions to find Azure-related Python files, check for direct instantiations of AzureOpenAI or AsyncAzureOpenAI classes outside specific allowed methods, and outputs issues detected.

methods.name: find_azure_files(base_dir)
methods.description: Finds all Python files in a specified base directory, used to locate Azure SDK interaction modules.

methods.name: check_direct_instantiation(file_path)
methods.description: Analyzes a Python file to detect direct instantiation of AzureOpenAI or AsyncAzureOpenAI outside of allowed methods, reporting issues.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main execution function that scans Azure SDK modules and reports any unauthorized instantiation patterns.
